liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **All Along the Watchtower** (2 reviews): Believed to be the first east coast performance of Watchtower; Crowd was excited for the first east coast Watchtower [14][18]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Bertha has an infectious melody; Jerry plays a well-formed line while Brent seems subdued [23]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Reviewer vividly remembers the Dire Wolf, among new material in the middle of a long first set [15]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Lasting image is Jerry's beaming smile just as China Cat started [19]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): The wah effect on He's Gone is especially neat [24]

## Setlist highlights

- **When Puch Comes to Shove**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]
- **Goin' Down the hRoad Feelin' Bad**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [26]

## The recordings

- **gd87-07-02.sbd.nawrocki.6473.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 153 min; rated 4/5 by 23 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording is on the verge of feeding back, with too much audience mic in the composite; Reviewer wishes the recording were better [16][18]
- **gd1987-07-02.170974.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 157 min [4]
- **gd1987-07-02.167358.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 153 min [6]
- **gd1987-07-02.beyer.connor.tetzeli.fix-22057.35441.reflac.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 158 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [7]. Said about its sound: Beyer source is somewhat thin, and its original pitch was quite high [7]
- **gd87-07-02.beyerm88.connor.22057.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 25 songs; 154 min; rated 3.73/5 by 14 [8]. Said about its sound: Sounds like a good soundboard circulated widely, but not at the quality of Without a Net [24]

## Around the show

- Fans danced atop Genesee beer trucks under overcast skies; the writer recalls the neighborhoods around the stadium [14]
- Heavy rain fell on the drive; attendee walked in as Bertha moved into Walkin' Blues, with the band playing in the outfield of a small minor league ballpark [15]
- Old ballpark was much smaller than football stadiums; neighborhood around it was rough, and finding the van afterward took hours [18]
- Reviewer camped in the lot overnight, got near the stage, and heard Paul Simon's Graceland over the PA before the show [19]
- A 50-second pause occurred in which the crowd wanted Phil, followed by a rough Walkin' Blues [23]
- Local Rochester radio broadcast the In the Dark album the night before, and the parking lot was rocking to it [25]
- Only east coast show of that summer tour without Dylan, played in a small baseball stadium [14]
- First set was exceptionally long, about 12 or 13 songs [19]
- Attended this and the Foxboro show; Foxboro was weaker, perhaps because the band was tired from a four-hour drive [20]
- Band sounded far more energetic and confident here than at Foxboro a few days later [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd87-07-02.sbd.nawrocki.6473.sbefail.shnf**: source: update: Healy Ultramix > cass> DAT > CDR > EAC > addawav> CDWave > mkwACT [1]. Also: Healy Ultramix to cassette, DAT, CDR, then EAC and further conversion; seeded by Doug Nawrocki [1]
- **gd1987-07-02.170974.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [4]
- **gd1987-07-02.167358.senn441.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Doug Lamarre; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Doug Lamarre's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 441 mics > Sony D5M [6]
- **gd1987-07-02.beyer.connor.tetzeli.fix-22057.35441.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 22057 [7]. Also: Pitch was corrected by tuning each track against generated reference tones, with time and pitch adjusted individually [7]
- **gd87-07-02.beyerm88.connor.22057.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 1 Ultramatrix seeded by Doug Nawrocki shnid 6473 Set 2 Beyer Dynamic M88's>Sony TCD5M>CM [8]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Silver Stadium - July 2, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/july-2-1987) [28]
